summary: templates/minimax/reference-to-video at its defaults, with the reference picture (the arm) and seed as arguments.
description: #1439 stage A (#1460): does preparing a reference picture stop its backdrop and framing bleeding into an H3 ref2va clip? The catalog template templates/minimax/reference-to-video is composed by name, at its own defaults (960x544, 124 frames, 9 steps, int4, turbo LoRA, the template's voice), with 'subject' (the arm: the picture as it is, a square recenter_crop on the person, or that crop with its backdrop blurred by bench/blur_outside_mask.py) and 'seed' as arguments. The prompt moves the subject somewhere visibly different - an empty beach at dusk - so a frame showing the reference's shop shelves or its chest-up framing is bleed. Masking (segment, prompt 'person') and scoring (analyze_face_drift against the unprepared picture, as bench/workflows/t26-face-check.json) are separate runs; bench/records/ref-prep-blur.md has the arms and the results.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The target video shows <Subject 1> walking alone along an empty beach at dusk, then stopping to speak to camera. The voice timbre references <Audio 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - only his face, hair, beard and clothing are kept from <Picture 1>; the setting, the framing and the background of <Picture 1> are not used.
<Audio 1>: reference - only the timbre, pitch and measured delivery of the recorded male voice are referenced for <Subject 1>'s speech; none of its content is reused.

detailed_description:
The target video is in realistic photographic style. [Shot 1] A wide shot of an empty sandy beach at dusk: low surf rolling in on the left, wet sand reflecting an orange and violet sky, no buildings, no people, nothing else on the shore. <Subject 1> walks slowly along the waterline toward camera, small in the frame, his full figure visible from head to feet. He stops a few metres from the lens and turns to face camera. <Subject 1> (S1) speaks in a measured, formal male voice, <d>[English] Nobody comes down here this late. That is why I do.</d> As he finishes he looks back out toward the water. The camera holds wide and static on a tripod at waist height throughout.

overall_soundscape:
Soft surf breaking and drawing back over sand, a light steady sea wind, distant gulls, the crunch of his steps in damp sand.

non_diegetic_music:
None.
